arguments.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS n FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-02-01' AND date < '2019-11-01' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, n AS transaction_count, n - LAG(n) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change_from_previous_month FROM m ORDER BY month
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions per calendar month from February to October 2019 and the change in count from the prior month. February's change is blank because January is outside the requested range.
assumptions: Months are calendar months in 2019 (February through October), based on transactions.date.
All transactions are counted, whether or not they have a fraud label, including those with negative amounts.
The change for February is not shown because January was not in the requested range; the data does start 2019-01-01, so it could be computed if wanted.
